name: Adrenaline #1

date.source: The card itself: “Adrenaline #1 Card / Date: Wednesday 26th February 2003 / Venue: Fargo, North Dakota, Fargo Dome.”

notes: An awards card rather than a wrestling one: the fed booked no matches and spent the night honouring the roster of xCw, the promotion it had taken over the month before. Its own card says the wrestlers due to appear were not yet confirmed, and the results line on the front page still read 00/00/00 at the last capture.
